# Automatic transformation helper

<small>Source: [`R/autoTransform.R`](https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/heteroTests/blob/main/R/autoTransform.R) · Help: `?autoTransform`</small>

Chooses between no transformation, log, square root and Box–Cox
based on the Breusch-Pagan test statistic.

## Usage

```r
autoTransform(model)
```

## Arguments

`model`
:   A fitted model of class `lm`.

## Value

A list with elements `model` (the transformed fit) and
`method` indicating the chosen transformation.

## Examples

```r
data(mtcars)
m <- lm(mpg ~ wt + qsec, data = mtcars)
autoTransform(m)
```
